#include <Eigen/Dense>

using namespace Eigen;

// Compute CST (Constant Strain Triangle) 6x6 stiffness matrix
// nodes: 3x2 matrix of coordinates, E, nu, t
Matrix<double,6,6> cst_stiffness(const Matrix<double,3,2>& xy, double E, double nu, double t) {
    // Plane stress D matrix
    Matrix3d D;
    double c = E/(1.0 - nu*nu);
    D << c,      c*nu,   0.0,
         c*nu,   c,      0.0,
         0.0,    0.0,    c*(1.0-nu)/2.0;
    
    // Area
    double x1=xy(0,0), y1=xy(0,1);
    double x2=xy(1,0), y2=xy(1,1);
    double x3=xy(2,0), y3=xy(2,1);
    double A2 = (x2-x1)*(y3-y1) - (x3-x1)*(y2-y1); // 2*Area
    double A = 0.5*std::abs(A2);
    
    // B matrix (3x6)
    Matrix<double,3,6> B;
    double b1 = y2-y3, b2 = y3-y1, b3 = y1-y2;
    double c1 = x3-x2, c2 = x1-x3, c3 = x2-x1;
    B << b1, 0, b2, 0, b3, 0,
         0, c1, 0, c2, 0, c3,
         c1, b1, c2, b2, c3, b3;
    B /= A2; // divide by 2A
    
    Matrix<double,6,6> K = t*A * B.transpose() * D * B;
    return K;
}
